Exhibit & Sponsor

# Exhibit & Sponsor

#### Showcase Your Company

NPMA's power lies in our capacity to unite the essential stakeholders in pest management annually at PestWorld. As the premier event in the global pest management industry, there is no superior platform for introducing new services and products, as well as raising awareness of your brand among your target audience.

PestWorld draws in influential decision-makers from the pest management sector. Across four days, you'll engage with thousands of professionals in pest management from around the globe. This ensures that you'll be connecting with the appropriate individuals in the ideal location at the opportune moment.

---

#### Event Profile

PestWorld is the largest gathering of pest management professionals held each year. Attendance averages 4,000-4,500, with approximately 500 from outside the US, and features an exhibit hall of about 200-250 exhibiting companies.

#### Attendee Profile

Attended primarily by owners and managers of pest control companies from around the globe. On average, over 90 percent of those attending PestWorld have buying influence or decision-making authority.

---

### Have Questions? Watch the PestWorld 2026 Exhibitor Q&A!

This webinar covers deadlines and key points exhibitors should know as you begin planning your booth for the show.

Exhibit hall booths are currently sold out. Please join the waitlist to be notified when more if more space becomes available.

Exhibitor Benefits include:

- Network and conduct business with the anticipated total attendance of 4,000+.
- Exhibit Hall traffic generating activities such as lunches, food stations, bars, entertainment, and more encourage maximum floor traffic during open hours.
- One (1) time use each of the pre- and post-event attendee lists.
- NPMA logos for your convention marketing collateral.
- Company listing in the conference app.
- Access to keynote presentations and educational sessions — ideal opportunities to meet potential buyers (3 passes per 10’x10’ booth — an $900 value).
- Discounted PestWorld registrations for additional personnel.
- Hospitality suite privileges.

All Sponsorships* include:

- Recognition as a sponsor on all pre-event marketing and attendee communications and on-site signage, handouts, slides, etc.
- One time use each of the pre- and post-event attendee lists

*Companies that are looking to sponsor an event, but do not participate as an exhibitor, must commit to at least $7,500 in sponsorship dollars in order to gain access to the attendee list.

---

### PestWorld Opening Ceremony/General Session Sponsorships

All General Session Sponsorships include:

- Meet and greet attendees at the Opening Ceremony or General Session
- Opportunity to distribute one (1) small give away to attendees at sponsored event (item provided by sponsor)
- Company logo projected on large screens at the event
- Company representative to introduce the Opening Ceremony entertainment or General Session keynote speaker
- Recognition from the Master of Ceremonies during the events

## Opening Ceremony & Welcome Reception: $39,375/Allied Members | $59,065/Non-Members – (SOLD)

Two events for the price of one—these highly attended events have always been among the most exciting and popular events at PestWorld.

- Company name/logo printed on the Welcome Reception and cocktail napkins

## Wednesday General Session: $39,375/Allied Members | $59,065/Non-Members – (SOLD)

A highlight of the convention, this General Session traditionally attracts one of the largest audiences of any PestWorld event.

- Private photo opportunity for corporate representatives with keynote speaker, providing the contract allows.

## Thursday General Session: $34,125/Allied Members | $51,190/Non-Members – (SOLD)

The second General Session of PestWorld is another highlight of the convention and attracts one of the largest audiences of the week.

- Private photo opportunity for corporate representatives with keynote speaker, providing the contract allows.

---

### PestWorld Meal & Refreshment Break Sponsorships

All Meal and Refreshment Break Sponsorships include:

- Meet and greet attendees at the event entrance.
- Distribute a memento to attendees at the event entrance.
- Company name printed on napkins.

## General Session Coffee Breaks: $15,750/Allied Members | $23,625/Non-Members – 2 Opportunities (per break) (2 SOLD)

We all need our caffeine fix in the morning and this opportunity put your company right into the hands of PestWorld attendees! This sponsorship opportunity will provide attendees with that much needed caffeine boost during the in the morning before the general sessions on Wednesday and Thursday.

- This sponsorship includes your company logo printed on coffee cups or cup sleeves

## Exhibit Hall Lunch: $10,500/Session Allied Members | $15,750/Session Non-Members – 2 Opportunities (1 SOLD)

Sponsorship also includes logo floor clings (if venue allows) in exhibit hall on day of your sponsored lunch.

## Education Session Refreshment Break: $7,875/Allied Members | $11,815/Non-Members – 3 Opportunities

There’s nothing like a good caffeine fix to get you through the afternoon! This sponsorship opportunity will provide attendees with that much needed caffeine boost during the afternoon education sessions on Wednesday, Thursday, or Friday.

---

### NPMA Award Sponsorships

All Award Sponsorships include:

- Logo recognition on slide show while award is being presented in the Thursday General Session.
- Opportunity to provide a company representative to present the award on stage.

## Technology Adopter Award: $17,500 Allied Member | $26,250 Non-Member – (SOLD)

Recognizes NPMA member companies leveraging innovative technology to drive growth, improve efficiency, and strengthen their workforce in the evolving pest management industry.

## Excellence in Sustainability Award: $15,000 Allied Members | $22,500 Non-Members – (SOLD)

Recognizes pest management companies that demonstrate exceptional commitment to sustainable business practices and environmental stewardship within the pest control industry.

## Women of Excellence Award: $15,000 Allied Members | $22,500 Non-Members – (SOLD)
